Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Does Weather Control damage, when played by the acting minion, have to
be applied in the same sequence of effects as the one the Weather
Control card is played in?

That is, when the card is played, it sets up an effect "do 1 damage" to
be applied later in the prerange step. But can the acting Methuselah
pass priority after playing the card but before applying the damage, and
then get another set of effects (including the damage application) even
if the blocking Meth passes as well? Or is the acting Meth forced to
apply the damage before her first passing of priority, because the
blocking Meth might not have any effects to play at that time?

thanks,

Josh

(think this came up on the vtes yahoogroup recently too)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Joshua Duffin" <duff...@bls.gov> wrote in message news:2n9oh3F...@uni-berlin.de...

> Does Weather Control damage, when played by the acting minion, have to
> be applied in the same sequence of effects as the one the Weather
> Control card is played in?

Who plays Weather Control is immaterial. Once the pre-range damage effect
is set up, it will be handled before leaving the phase.

No Methuselah can therefore "pass" with this effect still pending.

> That is, when the card is played, it sets up an effect "do 1 damage" to
> be applied later in the prerange step. But can the acting Methuselah
> pass priority after playing the card but before applying the damage, and
> then get another set of effects (including the damage application) even
> if the blocking Meth passes as well? Or is the acting Meth forced to
> apply the damage before her first passing of priority, because the
> blocking Meth might not have any effects to play at that time?

The latter.

when she regains priority after the Weather Control is played, must
apply the damaging effect herself? I would have thought that it should
be applied by the blocking Meth since she "controlled" the effect
(meaning that the acting Meth would need to eventually pass on playing
more effects so that the blocking Meth can again take priority and apply
the Weather Control damage).
